summary: Damodar Valley Corporation (DVC) & Bokaro Power Supply Co. Ltd (BPSCL)
intro: Damodar Valley Corporation (DVC) and its joint venture Bokaro Power Supply Company Ltd (BPSCL) have announced 126 trainee posts – 108 Executive Trainees in DVC and 18 Management Trainees in BPSCL. The recruitment is through GATE 2025 scores, so there is no separate written exam.
Engineering graduates with a valid GATE 2025 score can apply online on dvc.gov.in till 6 December 2026 (11:59 PM). This recruitment was also published in Employment News (28 Nov – 4 Dec 2026).
table: Full-time B.E./B.Tech in relevant discipline + GATE 2025 score
GATE 2025 score, followed by interview/document verification as per notice

after: Discipline-wise and category-wise (UR/OBC/SC/ST/EWS) vacancies for DVC Executive Trainee are given in the official advertisement.

ul: Full-time Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology in the relevant discipline (minimum marks as per notice – reported as 65% for Gen/OBC-NCL/EWS and 55% for SC/ST/PwD).
A valid GATE 2025 score in the corresponding paper.

p: The upper age limit, category-wise age relaxation and the application fee are given in the official advertisements on dvc.gov.in. Please check them before applying – we will update this page when confirmed.

ul: Shortlisting on the basis of GATE 2025 score
Interview / Group Discussion and document verification as per the notice

ol: Open the ET/MT GATE 2025 advertisement and read it fully.
Register with your GATE 2025 registration number.
Fill the online form, upload documents and pay the fee (if applicable).
Submit before 6 December 2026 and save the printout.

faq: How many posts are in DVC & BPSCL Recruitment 2026?
126 posts – 108 Executive Trainees in DVC and 18 Management Trainees in BPSCL.
Is GATE required for DVC Executive Trainee 2026?
Yes. Selection is based on GATE 2025 scores.
What is the salary of BPSCL Management Trainee?
Basic pay of ₹50,000 in the ₹50,000 – ₹1,60,000 scale during training.
final: DVC & BPSCL Recruitment 2026 is a great PSU opportunity for engineers with a GATE 2025 score. Apply before 6 December 2026.

schema_description:
DVC and BPSCL are recruiting 126 trainees through GATE 2025: 108 Executive Trainees (DVC) and 18 Management Trainees (BPSCL – Mechanical 10, Electrical 4, C&I 3, Civil 1).

Eligibility: Full-time B.E./B.Tech in the relevant discipline with a valid GATE 2025 score.

Pay: BPSCL MT basic ₹50,000 (₹50,000–1,60,000).

Dates: Apply online at dvc.gov.in from 6 November to 6 December 2026.
